mapper.select: SELECT id, task_id, task_type, session_id, run_id, turn_id, status, attempt_count, failure_code, failure_message, input_ref, output_ref, created_at, updated_at, completed_at FROM agent_memory_task WHERE task_id = #{taskId} LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM agent_memory_task WHERE task_type = #{taskType} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'RUNNING') AND COALESCE(updated_at, created_at, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, INTERVAL 30 MINUTE)

SELECT id, task_id, task_type, session_id, run_id, turn_id, status, attempt_count, failure_code, failure_message, input_ref, output_ref, created_at, updated_at, completed_at FROM agent_memory_task WHERE status = 'FAILED' AND attempt_count < #{maxAttempts} ORDER BY updated_at ASC, id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE agent_memory_task SET status = 'RUNNING', attempt_count = attempt_count + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE task_id = #{taskId}
UPDATE agent_memory_task SET status = 'SUCCEEDED', output_ref = #{outputRef}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, completed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE task_id = #{taskId}

UPDATE agent_memory_task SET status = 'FAILED', failure_code = #{failureCode}, failure_message = #{failureMessage}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, completed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE task_id = #{taskId}
